command:
set -eu
printf 'distro='
. /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' "$PRETTY_NAME"
printf 'uid='
/usr/bin/id -u
printf 'kernel='
/usr/bin/uname -r
printf 'compiler_path=/usr/bin/cc\n'
printf 'compiler_resolved='
resolved=$(/usr/bin/readlink -e /usr/bin/cc)
printf '%s\n' "$resolved"
printf 'compiler_sha256='
/usr/bin/sha256sum "$resolved"
printf 'compiler_stat='
/usr/bin/stat -Lc '%u:%g:%a %n' "$resolved"
if /usr/bin/mountpoint -q /mnt/d; then
  printf 'repo_mount='
  /usr/bin/findmnt -n -o SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS --target /mnt/d
else
  printf 'repo_mount=NOT_MOUNTED\n'
fi
if [ -L /opt/vst-runtime ]; then
  printf 'runtime_selector=SYMLINK:'
  /usr/bin/readlink /opt/vst-runtime
elif [ -e /opt/vst-runtime ]; then
  printf 'runtime_selector=NON_SYMLINK\n'
else
  printf 'runtime_selector=ABSENT\n'
fi
if [ -e /var/lib/vst-runner/private/store.sqlite3 ]; then
  printf 'store=PRESENT\n'
else
  printf 'store=ABSENT\n'
fi
for s in vst-assignment-bootstrap.service vst-dispatch-issuer.service vst-dispatch-owner.service vst-dispatcher.service vst-runner.service vst-sandbox-probe.service vst-signer.service vst-supervisor.service; do
  printf 'unit=%s ' "$s"
  /usr/bin/systemctl show --property=LoadState --property=ActiveState --property=SubState --property=Job --value "$s" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' ' '
  printf '\n'
done
stdout:
distro=
uid=0
kernel=6.6.114.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2
compiler_path=/usr/bin/cc
compiler_resolved=
compiler_sha256=
scope: read-only system/compiler/selector/Store/unit observations; no bundle install, service start, runtime test or activation
